name: Through the Ages
summary: Civilization-building board game where players develop technologies, wonders and military to earn culture points.
rules_text: Each player has a board with population, production, science and military. A row of civil cards is available from current age decks. On a turn a player gets civil actions and military actions. Civil actions are used to take cards from the row, increase population by paying food, build buildings, research technologies, elect leaders and build wonders. Military actions are used to draw and play military cards for tactics, defenses, aggressions, wars and pacts. After actions, produce resources, food, science and culture from your workers and buildings. Corruption, happiness and military strength must be maintained. When a civil deck empties, an Age ends: discard old-age cards from hand, remove old unfinished wonders and leaders, lose yellow tokens, and switch to next age decks. Short game ends after Age II empties plus final equal turns; full game after Age III. Most culture wins.
aliases: Through the Ages: A New Story of Civilization
rating_reason: Card-driven civ game, strategic, hidden hands, no map dependency
